text: Made in a continuous freezer: the mix flows through a refrigerated barrel where blades scrape off the frozen layer, and it is drawn straight into the container. Fast passage keeps air low and ice crystals small; the air is worked in by agitation, not added as an ingredient. The yolk gives a denser, richer body.
